from.place: Proof, ordinary scalar direct-image comparison: compatibility with successor transitions

title: Transition compatibility of normalized scalar direct-image components
statement: Let C be the prescribed ordinary scalar restriction of [lem-sf-semilinear-scalar-restriction], from the actual varying-ring systems of [def-sp-varying-ring-operations] to strict B towers. Fix f:X -> Y and a system M on X. Suppose d_n is a family of isomorphisms from the n-th level of C_Y(push_f M) to the pushforward of the n-th level of C_X(M), and after postcomposing by the pushed C_X level identification each d_n agrees on sections with the C_Y level identification. Then the d_n commute with every successor transition, hence can be assembled as a morphism of towers. No claim about constructing the d_n, functoriality in M, inverse-image mates, or open extension is made.

source.place: Construction 4.1, coefficient systems and ordinary direct-image transition maps; agent-written compatibility of section-normalized coefficient restriction

proof.text: Postcompose the asserted successor square with the pushforward of the n-th C_X level isomorphism, and evaluate on sections. The given normalization and C_Y.transitions identify the left side with the horizontal successor restriction of the level n+1 section. In the actual direct image, base change changes only the site coordinate: its functor maps the identity site arrow to the identity, so this horizontal section restriction is the one on X. Use the normalization at n+1, then C_X.transitions, and the section formula for pushed morphisms to identify the right side. Extensionality and cancellation of the pushed level isomorphism prove the square.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryScalarDirectComponents_step (C : OrdinaryScalarRestriction R φ B ψ)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : Modules R φ X)
    (d : ∀ n : ℕ, (((C.rho Y).obj ((push R φ f).obj M)).obj (op n)) ≅
      (StrictTower.moduleDirectImage B f).obj (((C.rho X).obj M).obj (op n)))
    (hd : ∀ (n : ℕ) (H : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (x : (((C.rho Y).obj ((push R φ f).obj M)).obj (op n)).val.obj H),
      HEq (((StrictTower.moduleDirectImage B f).map ((C.level X n).hom.app M)).val.app H
        ((d n).hom.val.app H x))
        (((C.level Y n).hom.app ((push R φ f).obj M)).val.app H x))
    (n : ℕ) :
    (((C.rho Y).obj ((push R φ f).obj M)).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) ≫
        (d n).hom =
      (d (n + 1)).hom ≫ (StrictTower.moduleDirectImage B f).map
        (((C.rho X).obj M).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)
